entities.name: João de Lisboa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: João de Lisboa was a Portuguese explorer. He is known to have sailed together with Tristão da Cunha, and to have explored Río de La Plata and possibly the San Matias Gulf, around 1511–12. The Brazilian historian Francisco Adolfo de Varnhagen erroneously stated that he was in Ferdinand Magellan's circumnavigation voyage.
